hypotheses.title: Operating Cash Flow Yield and Cash Acceleration Synergy
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Operating Cash Flow from announced analyst records (anl4_cfo_value) scaled by close provides clean, unaccrued cash generation yield. Combining historical cash yield percentile with 60-day cash flow acceleration within homogeneous subindustries identifies firms whose organic cash generation is expanding at an accelerating rate relative to immediate sector peers.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha returns fail to outperform when aggregate corporate cash generation stagnates.

candidates.expression: 0.65 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(anl4_cfo_value, 60) / close, 180), subindustry) - 0.5, 2) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_delta(ts_backfill(anl4_cfo_value, 60), 60) / close, subindustry) - 0.10 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, subindustry)
